templates.why_chosen: A minimal three-hop client-server-kernel chain drawn left to right, with reserved GPU(s) explicitly labelled on the kernel icon and bold double-headed arrows naming the HTTP/WebSocket and ZMQ protocols crossing each machine boundary.
templates.what_to_learn: Label the protocol name directly on the arrow crossing each machine boundary (HTTP & WebSockets, ZMQ) instead of a generic line, and use flat, distinct icon colours per tier; a background/motivation tier diagram can stay this sparse since it only needs to set up the problem, not show internals.
